跟卡夫交谈之后林奇便开始处理接下来的事项，在他把奥尔丁的遗体下葬之后便回了之前的家，将一些必备物品带来了罗兰庄园。
“查看个人面板。”处理完全部事情之后，林奇终于有时间来查看下自己目前的实力了。
【人物面板！】
姓名：伊萨里斯·罗兰（林奇）
种族：人类（维里迪亚王国）
身份：npc（彩蛋角色）
等级：20
经验：9500
生命：400400
体力：200200
主职业：浪漫序列：序列8平衡舞者【lv10】
副职业：画师【lv3】
属性：力量40、速度30、耐力20、智力20、信仰7
特殊属性：魅力9、意志6、幸运？？？
技能：罗兰秘剑lv1、酒类鉴赏lv4、引力线lv10、情感扰乱lv1、引斥双衡lv10
（剩余技能点：0）
战力：45
【评价：你已经不再是之前的战五渣了，但在真正的强者眼中依然是一个弟中之弟。】
“查看主线任务。”林奇目前的实力已经足够自保了，以他本身序列8的实力加上他身上的各种禁物哪怕序列7的强者他也不惧。

【主线任务：浪漫终章】
1、序列8平衡舞者lv10lv10（已达成）
2、收集三份中序列奥秘途径神秘物质（03）
3、粉丝值达到10000（010000）
叮——
【发布新的主线任务】
1、请在公测前在国都建立自身势力。
势力要求：大本营（未完成）
成员要求：序列7（00）、序列8（13）、序列9（05）
2、在伊莱娜到达国都之前在国都声望值达到500（0500）
林奇看着眼前的任务陷入了沉思，下一次的晋升任务居然是需要粉丝值，而且通过主线任务也能看出来，在现实世界受到关注会获得粉丝值，在终末世界中获得的就是声望值？
系统的意思是要我在国都创建自己的势力，并且获得群众的爱戴，这样才能在主线中帮助到伊莱娜吗？
哪怕不帮助伊莱娜，林奇也打算建立势力。他需要帮手，无论是罗兰家族的没落还是奥尔丁舅舅的死都离不开永恒烈阳教会和索拉尔家族。
他享受了罗兰家族的金钱和势力，就有理由来帮助罗兰家族复仇。
更何况从他来到这个世界，奥尔丁就对他百般照顾，尽管照顾他的理由是因为他占据了伊萨里斯的身体，但这份恩情林奇是不会抛在脑后的。
这笔账，他肯定会讨回来。
第二天。
“卡夫，财产都整理完了吗？”林奇看着换了一份管家服的卡夫问道。
“整理完了，按照您的要求，罗兰家族的产业以及这座庄园都找专业人士做了估算，账单在这。”说着卡夫从兜里拿出了一张纸。

After talking to Kraft, Lynch began to deal with the next matters. After he buried Aldin's body, he returned to his previous home and brought some necessary items to Roland Manor.
"Check the personal panel." After dealing with all the matters, Lynch finally had time to check his current strength.
【Character panel! 】
Name: Isharis Rowland (Lynch)
Race: Human (Kingdom of Viridia)
Identity: NPC (Easter egg character)
Level: 20
Experience: 9500
Life: 400400
Physical strength: 200200
Main occupation: Romance Sequence: Sequence 8 Balance Dancer [lv10]
Sub-professional: Painter [lv3]
Attributes: Strength 40, Speed 30, Endurance 20, Intelligence 20, Faith 7
Special attributes: Charisma 9, Willpower 6, Luck? ? ?
Skills: Roland's Secret Sword lv1, Wine Appreciation lv4, Gravity Line lv10, Emotional Disturbance lv1, Attracting Double Balance lv10
(Remaining skill points: 0)
Combat strength: 45
[Evaluation: You are no longer the fifth scumbag of Zhan before, but in the eyes of a true strong man you are still a younger brother among younger brothers. 】
"Check the main mission." Lynch's current strength is enough to protect himself. With his own Sequence 8 strength and the various forbidden objects on his body, he is not afraid even of Sequence 7 experts.
[Main Mission: Romantic Final Chapter]
1. Sequence 8 Balance Dancer lv10lv10 (Achieved)
2. Collect three copies of mysterious substances with mysterious pathways in the medium sequence (03)
3. The fan value reaches 10,000 (010000)
Ding——
[Release of new main quests]
1. Please establish your own power in the capital before the public beta.
Faction requirements: Base camp (unfinished)
Member requirements: Sequence 7 (00), Sequence 8 (13), Sequence 9 (05)
2. Before Elena arrives in the capital, her reputation in the capital reaches 500 (0500)
Lynch looked at the task in front of him and fell into deep thought. The next promotion task actually requires fan points, and it can also be seen from the main mission. Fan points will be obtained by receiving attention in the real world, but reputation points will be obtained in the end world?
Does the system want me to create my own power in the capital and gain the love of the people, so that I can help Elena in the main storyline?
Even if he doesn't help Elena, Lynch plans to build power. He needs help. Whether it is the decline of the Roland family or the death of Uncle Aldin, it is inseparable from the Eternal Sun Church and the Solar family.
Since he enjoys the money and power of the Roland family, he has reason to help the Roland family in revenge.
What's more, since he came to this world, Aldin has taken care of him in every possible way. Although the reason for taking care of him is because he has taken over Isharis' body, Lynch will not leave this kindness behind.
He will definitely get this debt back.
the next day.
"Kraft, have all the properties been sorted out?" Lynch asked looking at Kraft who had changed into a butler's uniform.
"It's all sorted out. According to your request, the Roland family's property and this manor have been estimated by professionals. Here is the bill." Kraft took out a piece of paper from his pocket.
